entries.title: John 20:1
segments: ¶Now on the first [day] of the week Mary Magdalene went to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw [that] the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

entries.title: John 20:2
segments: Then she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him."

entries.title: John 20:3
segments: Peter therefore went out, and the other disciple, and were going to the tomb.

entries.title: John 20:4
segments: So they both ran together, and the other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

entries.title: John 20:5
segments: And he, stooping down and looking in, saw the linen cloths lying [there]; yet he did not go in.

entries.title: John 20:6
segments: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb; and he saw the linen cloths lying [there],

entries.title: John 20:7
segments: and the handkerchief that had been around His head, not lying with the linen cloths, but folded together in a place by itself.

entries.title: John 20:8
segments: Then the other disciple, who came to the tomb first, went in also; and he saw and believed.

entries.title: John 20:9
segments: For as yet they did not know the Scripture, that He must rise again from the dead.

entries.title: John 20:10
segments: Then the disciples went away again to their own homes.

entries.title: John 20:11
segments: ¶But Mary stood outside by the tomb weeping, and as she wept she stooped down [and looked] into the tomb.

entries.title: John 20:12
segments: And she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

entries.title: John 20:13
segments: Then they said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him."

entries.title: John 20:14
segments: Now when she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing [there], and did not know that it was Jesus.

entries.title: John 20:15
segments: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?" She, supposing Him to be the gardener, said to Him, "Sir, if You have carried Him away, tell me where You have laid Him, and I will take Him away."

entries.title: John 20:16
segments: Jesus said to her, "Mary!" She turned and said to Him, "Rabboni!" (which is to say, Teacher).

entries.title: John 20:17
segments: Jesus said to her, "Do not cling to Me, for I have not yet ascended to My Father; but go to My brethren and say to them, 'I am ascending to My Father and your Father, and [to] My God and your God.'"

entries.title: John 20:18
segments: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and [that] He had spoken these things to her.

entries.title: John 20:19
segments: ¶Then, the same day at evening, being the first [day] of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, "Peace [be] with you."

entries.title: John 20:20
segments: When He had said this, He showed them [His] hands and His side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.

entries.title: John 20:21
segments: So Jesus said to them again, "Peace to you! As the Father has sent Me, I also send you."

entries.title: John 20:22
segments: And when He had said this, He breathed on [them], and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: John 20:23
segments: "If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain the [sins] of any, they are retained."

entries.title: John 20:24
segments: Now Thomas, called the Twin, one of the twelve, was not with them when Jesus came.

entries.title: John 20:25
segments: The other disciples therefore said to him, "We have seen the Lord." So he said to them, "Unless I see in His hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into His side, I will not believe."

entries.title: John 20:26
segments: ¶And after eight days His disciples were again inside, and Thomas with them. Jesus came, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, "Peace to you!"

entries.title: John 20:27
segments: Then He said to Thomas, "Reach your finger here, and look at My hands; and reach your hand [here], and put [it] into My side. Do not be unbelieving, but believing."

entries.title: John 20:28
segments: And Thomas answered and said to Him, "My Lord and my God!"

entries.title: John 20:29
segments: Jesus said to him, "Thomas, because you have seen Me, you have believed. Blessed [are] those who have not seen and [yet] have believed."

entries.title: John 20:30
segments: And truly Jesus did many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book;

entries.title: John 20:31
segments: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in His name.
